This came in IIM B UGAT 2025 👀

HCF 14, LCM 168, m < n and m divides 84. What is the largest m?

Pause, try it, then watch the solution. The full 2025 paper is on the IPM Careers portal: study.ipmcareer.com

Voice: Piper TTS, LibriTTS dataset (CC BY 4.0)

#IIMBUGAT #IIMBangalore #PYQ #IPMCareers #Quant
answer: (b) 42: m = 14a, n = 14b with ab = 12, so (a, b) = (3, 4) gives m = 42, n = 56
